provenance.calibration: unchanged from 0.2.1 (so the replay isolates the availability change)
provenance.change_from_0.2.1: Report status sets a probability of playing instead of certainty; a player missing from a submitted report no longer counts as cleared after a long absence; Doubtful = out
provenance.doubtful_weight: 0.75, the Doubtful weight already used by the NBA game engine's injury adjustment
provenance.play_prob_fit: official NBA injury reports 2023-24 (hoopR season 2024), last hourly report at or before tip-30 ET; P(played | Available/Probable) by minutes-when-playing band <8 / 8-16 / 16-24 / 24+ = 0.364 / 0.640 / 0.918 / 0.993 (n 321 / 378 / 450 / 1436). Questionable (n 33, overall 0.42) = Available rates x 0.49. Test seasons 2024-25, 2025-26 not used.
provenance.return_minutes: python -m modelroom.nba.props.returns: fit 2016-22 (n=646/554/501 games back); held out 2023+: 0.740/0.848/0.937 minutes ratio, sd factor 1.215/1.216/1.186
provenance.unlisted_fit: 2023-24: rotation players (12+ min) who missed 3+ games and were absent from a submitted report played 12.2% of the time (n 1847)
